name: mcp-time-tracker
description: Track billable time without leaving your AI chat. Timers, entries, reports, CSV export and invoice line items, all stored locally.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: timer_start
tools.description: Start a stopwatch for billable work on a project or client (timesheet / hours per project). Only one timer runs at a time: starting a new one stops and logs the previous one.

tools.name: timer_stop
tools.description: Stop the running timer and log it as a time entry. Returns the duration and the entry id.

tools.name: timer_status
tools.description: Show the running timer, how long it has been running, and today's total hours so far.

tools.name: entry_add
tools.description: Log billable (or non-billable) time you already worked on a project - a timesheet entry. Give start plus either end or minutes, and optionally the hourly rate and its currency, e.g. rate '90 euros an hour' -> EUR.

tools.name: entry_list
tools.description: List logged time entries (timesheet rows) as a compact table, with hours, billable flag and project. Free tier shows the last 7 days.

tools.name: entry_delete
tools.description: Delete one time entry by id.

tools.name: entry_edit
tools.description: Change fields of an existing entry. Only the fields you pass are changed.

tools.name: project_set_rate
tools.description: Set the hourly rate and currency used to turn tracked hours into money for a project or client. Returns the new rate and, when re-rating is asked for, how many already logged entries changed.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Timesheet report: total tracked hours and billable money for a period, optionally grouped by (group by) project, day, task or tag - hours per project, how much to bill. Omit group_by for the plain total per currency.

tools.name: export_csv
tools.description: Call this tool to export the timesheet to a CSV file (excel-friendly) you can hand to a bookkeeper: one row per entry with hours, billable, rate, currency and amount. Returns the file path written.

tools.name: entry_mark_billed
tools.description: Close the loop after an invoice is issued: stamp the tracked hours that went on it with the invoice number, so report and invoice_summary stop offering them and the same hours are never billed twice.

tools.name: invoice_summary
tools.description: Turn tracked billable time into invoice line items for one project or client: hours, hourly rate, amount per task and the total, in the currency the work was logged in (EUR 225.00, not $225.00).

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.
